## Dataset Access
You can access the available dataset files here:

- [Download Metadata (CSV)](data/20250630_SCENES_metadata_integrated_modified.csv)
- [Download GoPro RAW (GPR)](link)
- [Download WP690 RAW](link)
- [Download registered Pairs (PKL)](link)

> Large assets (RAW images, registered pairs) will be hosted externally to keep this site lightweight and fast.  

### Recommended citation
These files are provided for research and educational purposes. Please cite the SCENES project when using this dataset:

> SCENES Consortium (2025). SCENES: An International Dataset of Naturalistic Visual Environments. [DOI link coming soon (sample only)](link)
